panel.name: Zefira
panel.what: A self-hosted VPN sales panel (FastAPI + SQLite). The admin creates users with traffic and time limits; each user gets one subscription link that works in all common VPN client apps.
panel.notes: One user can mix several protocols. Subscription link remarks show the plain username.

navigation.Dashboard: Totals (users, active, expired, disabled, expiring within 7 days, out of volume, pending start), sold/used volume, system CPU/RAM/disk/uptime, latest users.
navigation.Users: Search, sort, export CSV. Per user: QR, copy link, download configs, pause/enable, reset token+keys, edit, delete.
navigation.Inbounds: Extra ports/hosts per protocol. Every enabled inbound adds links for all users, labeled with the inbound name.
navigation.BackPack Tunnels: Iran/Kharej reverse tunnels: create node (transport, IPs, ports), copy token, download step-by-step setup guide, Check-now reachability probe.
navigation.Anti-Censorship: REALITY X25519 keypair generator (private key encrypted, reveal is audit-logged), SNI rotation list, obfuscated host, per-user subdomains, CDN SNI spoofing, block-direct-IP.
navigation.Site Blocker: Custom blocked domains + 15-domain porn preset, appended to every Clash config as DOMAIN-SUFFIX REJECT rules (500 max).
navigation.Update: Compares server with GitHub, shows incoming changelog, one-click pull + pip + restart on password confirm.
navigation.Settings: Password change, appearance, server/hosts, SSL, Telegram, backup/restore, audit log.

users.create: Users section: username (English letters/digits/underscore, 3-32), protocols, volume GB, days. Optional: note, device limit, start-on-first-use.
users.plans: Volume quota stops service at 100% until topped up or reset. Duration counts from creation unless start-on-first-use is on (countdown starts at first subscription fetch). Device limit is shown to clients as informational cap.
users.manage: Pencil edits note/volume/expiry/device-limit/usage. Extend adds days (expired accounts extend from today). Reset token rotates token AND all secrets. Deleting is permanent.
users.states: Active, Expired, Disabled (paused), Limited (out of volume), Pending (not started yet).
users.protocols_detail: VLESS/VMess/Trojan/Shadowsocks/Hysteria2: share links (3 endpoints each, SS 1). REALITY: VLESS+reality links with rotated SNI. WireGuard: .conf file (needs server public key in Settings). OpenVPN: .ovpn file (panel CA). L2TP/IPsec: server+username+password+IPsec PSK text guide (Windows/Android/iOS/strongSwan). Cisco AnyConnect: server+username+password, OpenConnect one-liner. SOCKS5: socks5:// user:pass link + Clash entry.

ai_actions.what: The chat bubble can DO things, not just answer: create users, extend days, add volume, reset usage, pause/enable accounts, find users, show stats, hand over subscription links. Just ask, e.g. 'make user ali with 50 gig 30 days vless', 'extend sara 15 days', 'top up reza 20 gig', 'reset usage of omid', 'pause karim', 'link of mina?', 'how many users?'
ai_actions.rules: I ask for missing pieces instead of guessing (username, volume, days). Destructive or sensitive jobs are NOT mine: deleting users, resetting tokens, backup/restore, updates, settings, API tokens, password changes — for those I explain exactly which button to press.
ai_actions.limits: Max 3 operations per chat turn, 30 chats/hour. Every action is audit-logged as AI_CREATE/AI_PATCH with the admin's name; created users trigger the usual Telegram notification.

client_setup.v2ray_family: Copy a vless/vmess/trojan/ss link, paste into v2rayNG (Android), Streisand/FoXray (iOS), NekoRay/NekoBox (desktop), or import the subscription URL (one link carries ALL protocols). Clash users import the ?format=clash URL.
client_setup.wireguard: Download the -wg.conf from the user dashboard or panel Download button, import into the WireGuard app. If it won't handshake, the server public key is missing: Settings → Server/Hosts → WireGuard server public key (from `wg show` on the server).
client_setup.openvpn: Download the .ovpn (CA+cert+key embedded), import into OpenVPN Connect / Tunnelblick. Match proto (UDP/TCP) and port with Settings.
client_setup.l2tp: Use the -l2tp.txt credentials. Windows: Settings → Network → VPN → Add VPN, type L2TP/IPsec with pre-shared key, enter server, username, password, PSK. Android: Settings → Network → VPN → L2TP/IPsec PSK. iOS: Settings → General → VPN → Add L2TP (server, account, password RSA SecurID off, shared secret = PSK). Needs UDP 500/4500/1701 open on the server; the operator must create the matching server-side user entry first.
client_setup.cisco: Install OpenConnect (or AnyConnect app). Command: openconnect --user=USERNAME SERVER. AnyConnect app: add server, sign in with the panel username+password. Default port 443 (Settings → Cisco port).
client_setup.socks5: Use the socks5:// link: Telegram → Settings → Data and Storage → Proxy → Add SOCKS5 (server, port 1080 default, username, password). Browsers via SwitchyOmega/FoxyProxy. Clash: included automatically as a socks5 proxy.

tunnels_walkthrough.backpack: STEP 0: install BackPack on BOTH servers (Iran + Kharej) via its install script. STEP 1 Iran server: run backpack → Setup Iran → transport, tunnel port, tunnel name, TOKEN (from Zefira node create, same on both sides), exposed ports like 443:8000, UDP flag, Turbo preset. STEP 2 Kharej: backpack → Setup Kharej → same values + Iran address. STEP 3: Status on both, Health Check on errors, then Zefira Check-now probes Iran-ip:tunnel-port. Token secrecy = tunnel security.
tunnels_walkthrough.transports: Dirty routes: TCP+Stealth or WSS/WSS-Mux. UDP apps (WireGuard/DNS/games): enable Forward UDP + KCP/QUIC transports.
tunnels_walkthrough.server_nodes: Settings-free monitoring: Nodes section registers remote servers (address + check port). Health every 5 min (status/latency/uptime). Pin inbounds to a node; offline/disabled nodes are auto-excluded from all subscription links until recovery. Delete unpins to local.

antifilter_cookbook.reality: Anti-Censorship section: Generate REALITY keypair (private stays encrypted, reveal is audit-logged), paste private key into the Xray server config. Links rotate SNI from the SNI list automatically (xtls-rprx-vision flow).
antifilter_cookbook.layers: Stack for dirty networks: REALITY or Hysteria2 protocol + obfuscated host (a weird CDN URL hiding the real IP) + per-user subdomains (wildcard DNS *.host required, each user gets a random prefix) + CDN SNI spoofing + block-direct-IP (panel reachable only via domain).
antifilter_cookbook.diagnose: Sub 404 for everyone: check user expiry/volume/active first, then domain/ports in Settings, then server firewall ports, then REALITY keys/WireGuard pubkey. Clients can't connect but sub loads: almost always server-side ports or keys.

subscription.browser: Opened in a browser shows a personal dashboard: status, usage ring, days left, last-active time+IP, import buttons, per-protocol links, WireGuard/OpenVPN/L2TP/Cisco configs, SOCKS5 link, QR, app downloads.
subscription.clients: VPN apps get raw bytes (base64 links) or Clash YAML (?format=clash). Expired/disabled/limited users get 404 without revealing why. subscription-userinfo header carries quota for client progress bars.
subscription.leak: If a link leaks, Reset token kills it instantly and issues a new one.

settings.server_hosts: Domain/IP, VLESS/VMess/Trojan/SS port, Hysteria2 port, WireGuard port, OpenVPN port+proto, L2TP port, Cisco port, SOCKS5 port, DNS, WireGuard server public key, obfuscated host, per-user subdomains, block-direct-IP. Baked into newly generated links.
settings.tunnel: Public base URL (fixes links/QR behind proxy/tunnel) + trusted proxies (only these may send X-Forwarded-For).
settings.ssl: One-click Let's Encrypt issue/renew for domain or sub.domain. Needs DNS->server, free port 80, certbot installed.
settings.telegram: Bot token (encrypted) + chat id. Notifies on user create/delete and brute-force lockouts. Send the bot a message once before testing.
settings.backup_restore: Download needs password. Restore needs password, wipes users, skips bad rows, re-validates settings.
settings.appearance: Accent/background/card colors (live theme.css), brand name replacing ZEFIRA, message pinned on all user dashboards. Included in backups.
settings.account: Password change kills other sessions immediately.

security_model: scrypt passwords, JWT in HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies (Secure behind HTTPS), 8 logins/15min per IP+user, CSRF header on mutations, strict CSP, encrypted secrets at rest (Fernet, host-local key in instance/secret.key), audit log of last 2000 events. Backups hold password hashes: guard them like passwords.

troubleshooting.too_many_attempts: 8+ failed logins in 15 min. Wait, or restart the panel (in-memory counters reset).
troubleshooting.password_lost: Only works on fresh DB via env/.env; otherwise stop service, delete instance/zefira.db (lose data!), restore from backup, restart.
troubleshooting.sub_404: User expired/disabled/out-of-volume, token was reset, or SUBSCRIPTION_PATH was renamed.
troubleshooting.clients_cannot_connect: Open VPN ports on firewall; check Settings domain/ports; generate REALITY keys; paste WireGuard server public key.
troubleshooting.ssl_fails: Port 80 must be free, DNS must point here, certbot installed, mind Let's Encrypt rate limits.
troubleshooting.panel_down: systemctl status zefira; journalctl -u zefira -n 100; check port 8000 is free.
